evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies src/httprpc.cpp, src/rpc/request.cpp, and src/bitcoin-cli.cpp to overhaul whitelist rejection responses.
rationale: Fixes specification non-compliance for JSON-RPC 2.0 by returning structured error bodies on `-rpcwhitelist` denials instead of empty HTTP 403 responses. As noted in the description, the empty reply causes broken behavior in `bitcoin-cli -ipcconnect` (printing confusing JSON type errors) and fixes `bitcoin-cli -generate` silently ignoring errors from `generatetoaddress`.
